Rebecca — thanks for the clear ask. Attached are two concise options and an implementation timeline: a) Downgrade-with-proration (keep base Professional for remaining seats, remove 25 seats effective Jan 1 with proration and 30‑day notice) and b) Compact+Burst Add-on (switch to Compact plan, add a burst pool that auto-scales for peak inference).

Key bullets:
- Cost: Downgrade path reduces monthly recurring by ~18% after proration; Compact+Burst reduces base by ~35% but adds a small burst charge tied to peak tokens. See page 2 of the attached PDF for modeled scenarios based on your usage profile.
- Credits & seat handling: For downgrades we recommend 1 month of carry-forward credits to avoid immediate usage friction; Compact migration includes a 2-week sandbox and no seat carry because seats are managed at the organization level.
- Timeline: Downgrade can be done in 2 business days once PO is approved; Compact migration ~2–3 weeks (sandbox + config + CS handoff).

I've also included a simple Seat_Reduction_Workflow.xlsx that your procurement team can use to map affected users, entitlements, and rollback points.

Next steps: I can turn this into a formal quote (DocuSign) if Procurement confirms the preferred path — happy to schedule a 30-minute call with our CS engineer to walk the migration steps.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Director, Commercial Sales | Redwood Inference

Rebecca — adding a couple practical notes from the product side:

1) Feature bundling: If you need the Advanced Quality Monitoring and routed fallback (to avoid latency spikes), we recommend bundling those as a single add-on SKU — cheaper than buying them ala carte. That keeps your Compact base low while preserving core reliability.
2) Testing: For the Compact migration we require a 10‑day validation window in the sandbox where we'll mirror production traffic. This is usually enough to tune batching and KV cache settings to hit your SLA.
3) Rollback: We’ll keep the old configuration snapshot for 30 days; reactivating seats is automated but seat re-provisioning times vary by region (US: typically <4 hours).

If Procurement wants a single figure for budget approval, Markus — can you produce a priced Compact+Add-on quote and a priced Downgrade-with-proration quote? Rebecca — happy to join the pricing call if you want an ops-level walkthrough.

— Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Head of Customer Success | Redwood Inference
